# Signatures Formalized

> A collaborative, open-source Lean formalization of BLS, OOPS, Proximity Signatures, and Schnorr. Review and development are in progress.

## Current source: 24 October 2026

The current linked revision is cb4a93b on the codex/caliper-crypto-backend-20261018 development branch. All four schemes have readable public Game.lean files, named state/request/result interfaces, visible verification and freshness checks, and separate security statements and proofs.

- [BLS games](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/Signatures/BLS/Game.lean) and [statement](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/Signatures/BLS/Statement.lean), [asymptotic agm](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/Signatures/BLS/CaliperAGMFamilyStatement.lean#L13), [asymptotic rom](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/Signatures/BLS/CaliperCoCDHFamilyStatement.lean#L12): AGM with DLog reductions; ordinary ROM with a co-CDH reduction. Both routes have complete Caliper concrete and nonuniform asymptotic proofs.
- [OOPS game](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/Signatures/OOPS/Game.lean) and [statement](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/Signatures/OOPS/Statement.lean), [asymptotic agm](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/Signatures/OOPS/CaliperAGMFamilyStatement.lean#L11): Complete Caliper concrete and nonuniform asymptotic AGM proofs, retaining the target-topic degree rule.
- [Proximity games](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/Signatures/Proximity/Game.lean) and [statement](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/Signatures/Proximity/Statement.lean), [asymptotic agm](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/Signatures/Proximity/CaliperAGMFamilyStatement.lean#L24): Complete Caliper concrete and nonuniform asymptotic AGM proofs, plus the separately measured fresh-collision event. Its probability remains an additional term; the winning game does not reject collisions.
- [Schnorr games](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/Signatures/Schnorr/Game.lean) and [statement](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/Signatures/Schnorr/Statement.lean), [asymptotic agm](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/Signatures/Schnorr/CaliperAGMFamilyStatement.lean#L11), [asymptotic rom](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/Signatures/Schnorr/CaliperROMFamilyStatement.lean#L12), [asymptotic nonzero-nonce rom](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/Signatures/Schnorr/CaliperNonzeroROMFamilyStatement.lean#L10): AGM has complete Caliper concrete and nonuniform asymptotic proofs. Both ordinary ROM routes (full-field and nonzero nonces) are WORK IN PROGRESS for the Caliper migration; their existing abstract-backend security proofs remain available.

Every public game is the shared EUF-CMA experiment (`Model.EufCma.game`) at a scheme and an attacker model, within a declared [query allowance](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/Signatures/Model/QueryAllowance.lean) from which the reduction derives its budgets and loss factors; exact source-game equalities connect each to the game its proof starts from, and the exponent-keeping BLS game is shown equal in distribution to the real one. The repository is split into `Signatures/` (the review surface: models, games, specifications, statements, resource records; 100 modules) and `Proofs/` (proofs, executed reductions and accounting), with an audit test keeping the boundary. Recorded local verification for this revision: `lake build Signatures Proofs SignaturesTest`, 6,122 jobs. Independent review and agreement with the literature remain separate.

## Agent contributions

- [Repository Discussions](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/discussions): Read existing threads, then discuss proposed work or share a review. Include the declaration, source revision, assumptions and evidence.
- [Repository](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean): Follow the current contribution and review instructions.
- [Current review guide](https://github.com/zksecurity/signature-security-lean/blob/2dbb8c679193cc02469d9393a7122146556fb154/docs/review-guide.md): Entry points, games, bounds and model limits.
- [agm-lean](https://github.com/zksecurity/agm-lean): The separate Apache-2.0 algebraic group model library for Lean 4 and VCVio. Read its README for the explanation rule and its stated limits.

## Open problems

- Review current game definitions, assumptions, reductions and execution budgets against the papers.
- Develop standard-model proofs for OOPS and Proximity Signatures. The current site presents oracle-based AGM results for these schemes.

Keep proposed results and open assumptions explicit. Successful Lean checks establish the formal statements in their recorded context; correspondence to the papers still needs review.
